I’m sorry—I don’t have access to detailed historic weather records from more than two years ago. I can give you an idea of what Atlanta’s **average** conditions look like around early March:

|--------|---------------|
| High / Low temperatures | ~55–65°F (13–18°C) |
| Precipitation chance | ~30‑40% |
| Average rainfall | ~0.5 inches per day |

If you need precise figures for March 7, 2023, you might want to consult NOAA archives or a dedicated meteorological database. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
